senses.gloss: ch. same, to cry out, complain, lament.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 4:1">Targ. Esth. IV, 1</cite> (h. text <he>זעק</he>).
Targ. Ps. LXXVII, 2 (ed. Lag. a. oth. קַבֵּילִית Pa.; h. text צעק).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 22:22">Targ. O. Ex. XXII, 22</cite> (Y. <he>צוח</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 31b:17">Snh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>עוקבן</he> … <he>ק׳ קדמנא</he> ʿU. the Babylonian brought suit before us.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 59a:4-6">Kidd. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>אזיל</he> … <he>קַבְלֵיה לר׳ זירא</he> R. G. came and complained against him to R. Z.; <he>אזל ר׳ ז׳ וקבליה וכ׳</he> R. Z. went and laid the suit before &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:15">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:32">Y. Peah I, 15ᵈ</cite> <he>ק׳ לי על בריה וכ׳</he> he brought complaint before me against his son (asking) that he should support him; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 23:1">Pesik. R. s. 23-24</cite>; a. e.
Targ. Job XXXV, 9 (Bxt. מַקְבְּלִין Af.; h. text יזעיקו); v. supra.
